notes: Welcome to the Beta: Production Runner 0.1.0 is the first public beta: Dashboard, Screenplay, Breakdowns (with Cast ID and Reports), Shots, Contacts, Locations and Tasks, all working on your own computer.
Script to Shot List: Write or import a script, break it down into elements and cast, then plan your shots, all from the same scenes.

Hand off to Call Time: Choose File > Export for Call Time to send your scenes and shoot days to the Call Time crew app, and File > Import from Call Time to bring back what the crew reported. File > Shoot Days is where you set the days up.
